newsitem.title: USA: A.O. Smith Q1 net rises on higher margins.
newsitem.headline: A.O. Smith Q1 net rises on higher margins.

text.p: A.O. Smith Corp said Monday improved margins helped the company post a solid earnings gain in the first quarter ended March 31.
The company reported net income of $19.9 million, or $0.98 a share, compared to $17.3 million, or $0.83, a year ago.
Sales in the period rose to $196.2 million from $194.8 million in the first quarter of 1996, A.O. Smith said.
Company officials said demand in some of its markets was weak, but recent order activity indicates that demand should begin to recover in the coming months.
A.O. Smith is a diversified manufacturing company.
Its shares were up 1/4 Monday at 34-3/8.
